title: My kitten who's typically rude was desperate to wake me up
text: My kitten who’s typically rude was desperate to wake me up https://t.co/dKwVVl1hbz
blurb: Their human says this black kitten is usually rude, but this morning it was desperate to wake them up. Here it settles in on the blanket and accepts a head scratch like it was the plan all along.
